_comment_template: The version of DotNetSolutionKit the solution is generated with; dotskit upgrade moves it to the tool's
_comment_solution: The template's arguments of Common and the root: the names, the database, the deployment, the flags the services share
_comment_services: Each service by its own arguments; dotskit new adds one or joins flags to one
_comment_packages: How much of the template's package versions an upgrade brings

packages._comment_updates: minor: patches and minor versions of packages come with an upgrade; patch: patches only; none: no package version changes
packages._comment_pinned: Packages kept on the version given here, whatever the template brings; the upgrade report names each one
